extracted.name: Chocolate Chip Cookie Granola Bars
extracted.description: Chocolate chip cookie granola bars are chewy, soft, wholesome, and healthy!
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350°F (177°C). Spray a 8-inch square baking pan with nonstick spray. Set aside.

In a small bowl, melt the cookie butter and coconut oil for about 1 minute in the microwave. Stir until combined and smooth. Melt for longer if needed. In a large bowl, stir the melted cookie butter/oil mixture, honey (or maple syrup if you are using it instead), egg, and vanilla until completely combined. Add in the oats, brown sugar, and salt. Mix well. Slowly stir in chocolate chips. The batter will be sticky.

Transfer to the prepared baking pan and press down, making sure the surface is flat and even. Bake 21-24 minutes or until set and edges are lightly browned. Allow to cool completely before cutting into squares.
